name: Troggu
description: Troggu (Trogga) is a Swiss Tarot game from the German-speaking Valais. Uses a modified 62-card Tarot deck. 3-8 players. Features bidding (Normal/Solo), Tapp exchange, the unique Fool as highest trump, and Misere when all pass. The secret partner mechanic (calling a trump card) adds intrigue in 7-8 player games.

history.origins: Troggu is a Swiss Tarot game from the German-speaking Valais (Upper Wallis), played especially in the Visp area, St. Niklaus, and Grächen. Card game researcher John McLeod places its probable origin in the 18th century; the game's mix of Fool-as-excuse and Fool-as-highest-trump rules suggests a transitional form between older Tarot and modern Tarock. A related game may have reached Belgium in the 18th century, evidenced by Cartes de Suisses decks. Its closest relatives are Tape (Fribourg) and Dappen (Baden). After Troccas, Troggu is the second most played tarot game in Switzerland.
timeline: 18th century: probable origin; transitional Fool rules between classic and modern Tarot (Dummett/McLeod).
history.evolution: Second most popular Swiss Tarot game after Troccas.

setup.deck: 62 cards (78 minus low swords/batons and high cups/coins). 21 trumps + Fool + 40 suit cards. Total 114 pts.

rules.objective: Score 58+ of 114 card points (as declarer) or prevent it (as defenders).
rules.gameplay: Bid: Pass/Normal/Solo. Tappist exchanges with Tapp (no 5-pt cards). Solo plays without exchange. Follow suit; must trump if void. Fool = highest trump (special last-card rule). 7-8 players: Tappist calls a trump for secret partner.
keyRules: Fool as highest trump (with last-card exception)

strategy.basic: Bid when holding strong trumps/Kings. Exchange wisely with Tapp.
strategy.advanced: Count points. Manage last-card Fool rule.

variations.emptyOverridesReason: No documented variants with distinct rules; add overrides when sources found.

scoring.description: K/Bagat/TrXXI/Fool=5, Q=4, Cav=3, J=2, others=1. Total 114. 58+ to win. Double if opponent <30, triple if 0 tricks.
scoring.winCondition: Score 58+ of 114 card points (as declarer) or prevent it (as defenders).
